Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Let's say I control a Nosferatu in torpor and Warsaw Station.

Situation A:
My predator comes to diablerize my torporized Nosferatu.
If I burn the Warsaw Station to bring him into the ready
region before the action resolves, does the action fizzle?

Situation B:
Someone comes to rescue my torporized Nosferatu.
If I burn the Warsaw Station to bring him into the ready
region before the action resolves (for some reason), does
the action fizzle?
Is the cost still paid?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> Let's say I control a Nosferatu in torpor and Warsaw Station.
>
> Situation A:
> My predator comes to diablerize my torporized Nosferatu.
> If I burn the Warsaw Station to bring him into the ready
> region before the action resolves, does the action fizzle?

Yes. The cardless diablerie action can only target a vampire in torpor.

> Situation B:
> Someone comes to rescue my torporized Nosferatu.
> If I burn the Warsaw Station to bring him into the ready
> region before the action resolves (for some reason), does
> the action fizzle?

Yes. The cardless rescue action can only target a vampire in torpor.

> Is the cost still paid?

No. (cf. Vast Wealth and a second vehicle.)
